_comment: GLM-5.3-Flash on one PC. Copy to strata-glm5.json or let tools/glm5_ref/make_glm5_config.py write it. Paths: the pack from tools/iq_pack.py, shard 1 of the GGUF. --resident-budget-gib: the RAM the experts may take (total RAM minus ~30 GB; 98 on 128 GB). --pool-workers: physical cores minus 4 (20 on a 24-core Core Ultra 9 285K). Expert skipping (STRATA_GLM5_SKIP_*) is OFF unless you add it to env: it is about +30% decode for about one changed token in 100 on long reasoning.
